about: For a live three-check monitor run on a scratch copy of evals/fixtures/site: the baseline and check 1 come before the 'deploy'; the deploy adds a second load error (monitorBreak); checks 2 and 3 follow it. No alert may be confirmed before check 3, and a high alert for the new error must be confirmed at check 3. `qacheck.py expect <monitor.json> <this file>` checks the saved output of `qacheck.py monitor`.
